verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Remote serves an llms.txt at developer.remote.com, titled "Remote API Documentation". Its docs are published as .md pages, and it ships agent skills packaged as a plugin for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: the llms.txt contents are evidenced only by a short snippet, and there is no independent hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://developer.remote.com/llms.txt # Remote API Documentation
The plugin works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
